title: Surreal Desert Staircase
description: A woman in a red patterned robe and headscarf stands on a winding green spiral staircase that rises into the sky. The staircase is wrapped in a large colorful floral wreath with a green celestial sphere at its center, set within a vibrant desert courtyard framed by an archway.
prompt: A woman wearing a red patterned robe and headscarf stands on a green spiral staircase that twists upward into a swirling sky. The staircase is encircled by a large vibrant floral wreath with a glowing green celestial sphere at the top. The scene is set in a sunlit desert courtyard with terracotta buildings, potted lemon trees, colorful laundry hanging, and a stone pathway under a large yellow canopy, surreal fantasy style, highly detailed, vibrant colors.
